set.st: A Barron County farmer, on the place since about 1897, hid his savings in sacks and in the ground. After his wife died in July 1925 about $6,000 was recovered: a flour sack, a poppy-seed sack, some buried, and more than $1,000 in an old coat ruined by mice. He said "there is a large quantity of silver buried between the road and the house." No later dig or find was reported 1925-35. The pin is the farm on the 1915 plat.
